verdict.rationale: Dynadot's own docs state it offers free domain privacy that hides name, email, and phone in public WHOIS, including on transferred domains, so the free, no-upsell part is covered. Nothing in the pack shows privacy is enabled by default, and address redaction is not stated explicitly. Missing for 10: evidence that privacy is on by default, explicit address redaction, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a privacy-first user, WHOIS privacy is free and on by default — my name, address, and email stay redacted without an upsell

citations.quote: Dynadot offers free domain privacy, account lock, two-factor authentication, and optional Registry Lock to keep your online assets safe.
Hide your name, email, and phone in public WHOIS
Enjoy free privacy, 1-year renewal, and 24/7 support.
